title: Slider positions
description:
Map a slider's value to a handle position and back, as an immediate-mode UI does.

```
slider 0..100, 200 px wide: value 25 -> handle at 50 px
drag to 150 px -> value 75
drag to 300 px -> value 100 (clamped)
step of 5: 73 -> 75
```
hints: Rounding to a step: `std::round(v / step) * step`.
requirements: An optional step that rounds the value.
Integer and float versions (a template is fine).
stretch: Add Ctrl+click to type an exact value.
